description: init.sh creates .venv, installs, lints, checks links and runs every test offline
Seeded clean tables for customers, orders and inventory
Mess generator with 9 named messes and ground truth
Plan language with 12 operations, each with tests for valid and invalid arguments
Executor runs a plan on a copy. Input hash is the same before and after
steps: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_executor.py -k 'never_changed or refuses or invalid_plan'

description: Change log holds every change. Replaying the log on the input gives the same output
steps: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_executor.py -k 'replay or logged or encoding'

description: Profiler summarizes columns without the whole file. Examples come only from the 20 row sample
Verifier checks columns, types, ranges, uniqueness, allowed values and row counts
Rule baseline maps profile patterns to operations
Metrics (cell accuracy, row recall, duplicate F1, ops) and a benchmark of 40 dev and 24 held out datasets with bootstrap intervals
steps: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_pipeline.py -k 'suite or interval or score'

description: LLM planner sees only the schema, the profile and at most 20 rows. Fixture replay works
Record run with one free model, reported in the README table
README tables come from the results files and a test fails when they drift
Repo quality bar: README parts, CI, badge, topics, social preview, demo page, DEMO.md, issue templates
Release check: gitleaks, pip-audit, ruff S, actionlint, link check, outside review
Hand-off: CHANGELOG with release SHA, HUMAN_STEPS, COWORK_PROMPT, GITHUB_ABOUT, topics
Tests run offline. A guard blocks network access and has its own test
